title: An out-of-bounds write in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby user to send an HTTP request…
description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in certain ASUS Router firmware versions. This flaw allows an unauthenticated nearby attacker to send a specially crafted HTTP request with parameters exceeding buffer length, potentially overwriting memory or causing a system crash. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-787 and has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 7.1, indicating high severity. No specific affected versions or patch information is provided in the available data. No known exploits in the wild have been reported.
